findings.evidence: `grep -n "ContDiff\|uniqueDiffOn\|LipschitzRegularity\|EachSide" TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Winding/LipschitzBoundedIntegrand.lean` returns only line 7 (the import). Repo-wide `grep -rn asLipschitzDerivOnEachSideAt TauCeti` shows uses only in `Crossing/LipschitzRegularity.lean` and `Winding/RealIntegral/OnCurve.lean` (lines 181, 219, 226, 394, 422, 434, 457).
findings.fix: Drop the import from `LipschitzBoundedIntegrand.lean` and add `public import TauCeti.Analysis.Contour.Crossing.LipschitzRegularity` to `Winding/RealIntegral/OnCurve.lean`, which uses `HasLipschitzDerivOnEachSideAt` in four public signatures. Also fix `Crossing/LipschitzRegularity.lean`'s module docstring, which claims the predicate feeds `Winding.LipschitzBoundedIntegrand`.
findings.issue: `public import TauCeti.Analysis.Contour.Crossing.LipschitzRegularity` is unused: no declaration from that module (`HasLipschitzDerivOnEachSideAt`, `hasLipschitzDerivOnEachSideAt_iff`, `_of_lipschitzOnWith`, `_of_contDiffOn`) and no `ContDiff*` from its transitive Mathlib imports appears in this file. The only real consumer, `Winding/RealIntegral/OnCurve.lean`, obtains the predicate through this public re-export instead of directly.

summary: Placement is otherwise correct — the RealIntegral directory split, the new declarations' homes, and the deletion of the compatibility wrappers all check out — but Winding/LipschitzBoundedIntegrand.lean publicly imports Crossing/LipschitzRegularity.lean without using anything from it, and the actual consumer gets the predicate only via that re-export.
